summary: Core runtime and public frontend auth API now pass. SMTP remains blocked by shared provider/account login requirement, reproduced in Immense independently with matching settings.

acceptance.criterion: Container health, PostgreSQL, Redis and HTTP connectivity verified; limitations recorded.
acceptance.evidence: Core runtime and public frontend auth API now pass. SMTP remains blocked by shared provider/account login requirement, reproduced in Immense independently with matching settings.

checks.name: Core services
checks.evidence: All three containers healthy; migration check, PostgreSQL SELECT1, Redis PING, health JSON passed.

checks.name: Public API
checks.evidence: Config and CSRF HTTP200 valid JSON; token and Secure/SameSite cookie present.

checks.name: SMTP
checks.evidence: Local/server settings identical; 534/5.7.9 requests browser login. No mail sent.

checks.name: Immense comparison
checks.evidence: Auth/notification/user SMTP settings equal FIRST. Nodemailer verify in notification container independently returns EAUTH 534/5.7.9. No Immense changes.

risks: Email-dependent flows remain unavailable until SMTP provider access is restored.
followUps: Account owner completes provider browser login/security step; then retry SMTP.
